card_summary: Drier climate (lower sea-surface humidity, evaporation and ocean supply) plus lower mountains via the peak override (~3600 m).

events.transcript_tail:
Choose what to do, type a request, and press Send. The reply is shown here; nothing is saved until you press Save to note.
You
Make the climate drier and the mountains lower.
Looked up 8 matching actions first (about 508 tokens).
The model is reading the climate, weather, world settings…
MODEL PROPOSAL
“Drier climate (lower sea-surface humidity, evaporation and ocean supply) plus lower mountains via the peak override (~3600 m).”
Peak override (optional)  (peak_m)   5182 m  ->  3600 m   -31%   (default 4000 m)
    “Lower the mountains: ~31% below the current 5182 m override.”  (model's words)
Sea-surface humidity  (climate.ocean_hum)   1.00  ->  0.70   -30%
    “Drier sea air for a drier world (~30% cut).”  (model's words)
Evaporation  (climate.evap)   0.12  ->  0.09   -25%
    “Less moisture picked up over the sea.”  (model's words)
Ocean supply  (climate.ocean)   1.00 ×  ->  0.75 ×   -25%
    “Cut the global rain budget ~25% for a drier world.”  (model's words)
4 settings refresh the climate with Recompute in the status bar.
Applying changes the settings, then refreshes the climate. The world itself is not replaced.
[Dismiss]
[Apply and regenerate]
